commits.subject: Expand connector result metadata coverage across auth configurations (#62434)
commits.reason: Take the connector result tests and the upstream capture and send paths together. Preserve the existing feature default and the per-turn checks on the selected account and destination.
evidence: The model client passes the result destination through to turn selection. Only a sampling turn with the same ID, a selected destination and a current matching owner can attach retained result bodies.

The capture path rechecks the owner while holding the retained-body lock and keeps its count and byte budgets. The header iterator still rejects an unrecognized configured name, including an environment-backed name whose value is absent.

The expanded integration test uses separate loopback Apps and inference endpoints. It checks metadata grant and request budgets across direct and Code Mode calls, independent credentials, a header helper and the disabled private-results feature. General executed-call metadata and private result bodies have separate controls.
commits.revisit: Run the expanded direct and Code Mode cases on the integrated source. Revisit the grant checks when upstream changes the supported authentication modes or destination policy.
